title: Report Center
subtitle: Explore fixed, tenant-safe operational views with the exact scope applied by the server.

catalog.title: Reports
catalog.subtitle: Every report in one place. Open one to see its figures, then narrow it with the filters inside.

exports.title: Export applied view
exports.description: Create a CSV or Excel file from the complete applied view and its server-captured evidence.
exports.expiredGuidance: This artifact has expired. Create a new export from the current applied view.
exports.recoveryGuidance: If access or billing changed, restore reporting access and try again. Existing eligible exports remain recoverable during restricted billing.

exports.stalled: This export is taking longer than expected. It may have stopped — try again later or start a new export.

failures.ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE: The export was larger than the maximum file size. Narrow the filters and try again.

failures.RENDER_FAILED: The file could not be generated. Try again.
failures.UNKNOWN: The export could not be completed. Try again.
